title: RequestCompleted
description: Result: the HTTP Adapter called its configured external REST API in response to a trigger event, and got a real response back (Design.md §8, §13 Step H3). eventDetails.correlationId is set to the triggering event's eventId. Published only when a response was actually received — a genuine connection failure (the API unreachable, not just returning an error status) leaves the triggering command unacked for redelivery instead (Design.md §13), so there's nothing to report yet.

status.description: success: the external API returned a 2xx status. error: any other status (4xx/5xx) — this adapter reports the outcome, it doesn't judge it (Design.md §13).

statusCode.description: The external API's real HTTP status code.

body.description: The external API's raw response body, base64-encoded — not assumed to be JSON or even text, since the target is an arbitrary external API.

occurredAt.description: UTC timestamp (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601) the response was received.
